examples.title: Example 1: Setting Different Image Attributes
examples.description: This example applies different image effects.

examples.title: Example 2: Applying a Linear Gradient Blur Effect
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to apply a linear gradient blur effect on a component using linearGradientBlur.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting Offscreen Rendering Effect
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use renderGroup to set whether the component is rendered entirely offscreen and then composited with its parent component.

examples.title: Example 4: Blending the Current Component Content with Canvas Content
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to blend the current component content with the canvas content below using blendMode.

examples.title: Example 5: Inverting the Foreground Color
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to achieve intelligent foreground color inversion using InvertOptions.

examples.title: Example 6: Setting Non-Overlapping Same-Layer Shadows
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement non-overlapping shadow effect within the same layer using useShadowBatching in combination with shadow.

examples.title: Example 7: Applying a Spherical Effect to a Component
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to apply a spherical effect to a component using sphericalEffect.

examples.title: Example 8: Applying a Light Up Effect to a Component
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to apply a light up effect to a component using lightUpEffect.

examples.title: Example 9: Applying a Pixel Stretch Effect to a Component
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to apply a pixel stretch effect to a component using pixelStretchEffect.

examples.title: Example 10: Applying a System Bar Effect to a Component
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to apply a system bar effect to a component using systemBarEffect.
